name: operating-line
description: Connect Claude Desktop to a local OperatingLine runtime and its Blender guidance workflow.
long_description: OperatingLine turns AI-planned host actions into a visible, reviewable task tree inside Blender. This local connector forwards Claude Desktop MCP calls only to an explicitly configured OperatingLine runtime on the loopback interface. It does not launch Blender, execute a Plan, call a paid Planner Provider, or bypass Blender's Accept, Start, Next, and Back controls.

runtime_url.title: OperatingLine Runtime URL
runtime_url.description: Local MCP endpoint. Only loopback http URLs ending in /mcp are accepted.

access_token.title: OperatingLine Bearer Token
access_token.description: The same local token used by the OperatingLine runtime and Blender Companion (minimum 16 characters).
